_comment: Human book-curation sources for Book Scout. The agent pulls recent picks from these and attributes every recommendation to its human source. The AI NEVER recommends on its own taste — it only aggregates and filters these humans' picks. Add/prune sources over time; keep only sources where real people curate (editors, critics, booksellers, librarians), not algorithmic/crowd lists.

thrillers.name: The New York Times — Crime column
thrillers.notes: Long-running crime/thriller roundup by a named NYT critic. Gold standard.

thrillers.name: The Guardian — best recent crime and thrillers
thrillers.notes: Monthly roundup by The Guardian's crime critic.

thrillers.name: CrimeReads
thrillers.notes: LitHub's crime vertical. Monthly 'best new thrillers' / 'crime books of the month' lists by editors.

thrillers.name: Murder by the Book (Houston)
thrillers.notes: Specialist crime/mystery indie bookstore. Bookseller staff picks.

thrillers.name: The Poisoned Pen (Scottsdale)
thrillers.notes: Specialist mystery/thriller indie. Strong staff recommendations + signed first editions.

thrillers.name: The Mysterious Bookshop (NYC)
thrillers.notes: Oldest mystery specialist bookstore in the US. Bookseller picks.

thrillers.name: Kirkus Reviews — mystery/thriller
thrillers.notes: Professional reviews; starred reviews signal critic enthusiasm.

thrillers.name: BookMarks (Literary Hub)
thrillers.notes: Aggregates pro critic reviews into a rating. Use to confirm a thriller is broadly well-reviewed by humans.

_general.name: The New York Times — New & Noteworthy / Editors' Choice
_general.notes: NYT Book Review editors' weekly picks.

_general.name: Powell's Books staff picks
_general.notes: Large indie; well-known bookseller staff picks.

_general.name: Seattle Public Library — Peak Picks / staff
